caption: The drawing depicts a horizontal strip featuring a continuous, meandering vine with various floral and botanical elements rendered in delicate colors. The vine, primarily light brown and curving gently, runs horizontally across the length of the composition. Along the vine, clusters of round, dark blue shapes resembling grapes appear twice on the left, connected by thin, light brown stems. Several types of flowers are distributed along the vine, predominantly in shades of blue, pink, and a subtle yellowish hue. Two large blue flowers, each with a yellow center, are positioned to the left of center and far right, with smaller blue leaves nearby. Pink flowers, some with fuzzy or spiky petals, are scattered across the center and right sections, and small pink circular berries or buds are visible at intervals. Thin green leaves and curling tendrils extend from the vine throughout the composition. The entire design is drawn on a lightly shaded, grid-textured rectangular background, with the objects evenly spaced and interconnected by the undulating vine.
title: Bed Hanging
cluster: #01 — Textile Arts: Quilts, Samplers, and Embroideries
